review_a_and_adjudication.boundary: Exact pi-subagents 0.34.0 status.json startedAt/deadline/terminal state and events.jsonl lifecycle event bytes for one runId; pid is sampled only for that runId process tree.

review_b.boundary: Supervisor freezes unique start_event_id/start_message_id immediately before parent-written Review B work and end_event_id/end_message_id immediately after exact artifact bytes freeze. The inclusive interval contains only that PR-role review work.
required_source_bytes: exact supervisor session events from start_event_id through end_event_id
exact supervisor messages from start_message_id through end_message_id
exact session usage and tool events in that interval
review_b.isolation_rule: No collection, orchestration, other PR, other role, prediction, or lane-A inspection may occur inside the bounded Review B interval.

unavailable_rule: A measurement may be null only with a nonempty unavailable_reason. GO forbids null/unavailable_reason for every mandatory_go_field on every role and attempt; optional lifecycle fields inapplicable to the other source variant must be null with the fixed reason not_applicable_to_source_kind.

rss_measurement.review_a_and_adjudication: Supervisor samples the status.json pid and all descendants from procfs every 1000 milliseconds until terminal state, sums resident pages per sample, and retains the maximum.
rss_measurement.review_b: Supervisor samples its bounded Review B process tree from the start boundary through the end boundary every 1000 milliseconds, subtracts the frozen idle supervisor baseline without going below zero, and retains the maximum attributable RSS.

scoped_roots: pi-subagents run directory or supervisor interval artifact directory
disk_measurement.method: Supervisor records allocated bytes for each fixed scoped root immediately before and after every exact attempt boundary.

token_cost_rules.usage_source: Exact pi lifecycle/provider usage for pi_subagents_lifecycle_v1; exact supervisor session usage events inside the frozen interval for supervisor_session_interval_v1. input_tokens excludes cached_input_tokens so cost operands are disjoint.
token_cost_rules.pricing_units: Execution manifest freezes nonnegative integers input_micro_usd_per_million_tokens, cached_input_micro_usd_per_million_tokens, and output_micro_usd_per_million_tokens.
token_cost_rules.cost_formula: cost_micro_usd = ceil((input_tokens*input_rate + cached_input_tokens*cached_rate + output_tokens*output_rate)/1000000), using integer arithmetic.
token_cost_rules.pricing_source: Authenticated no-clobber execution manifest frozen before first attempt.

nullable_fields.retry_of_attempt_id: null exactly when is_retry is false; non-null exactly when is_retry is true
nullable_fields.failure_kind: null exactly when succeeded is true; nonempty exactly when succeeded is false
nullable_fields.artifact_sha256: null only when no artifact was produced
nullable_fields.status_sha256_and_events_sha256: required for pi_subagents_lifecycle_v1; otherwise null with not_applicable_to_source_kind
nullable_fields.supervisor_interval_and_boundary_ids: required for supervisor_session_interval_v1; otherwise null with not_applicable_to_source_kind
nullable_fields.unavailable_reason: null only when every applicable measurement is available
